title: Review of lab 1 membrane_evo L7[L3]: direction replicates on 2 fresh seeds against identical-event twins, but noisy and volatile; Weak
summary: Ran membrane_evo_up (b2 = 1.3 b) and its identical-event twin membrane_evo (b2 = b) on fresh seeds 21 and 22 with the pack's settings (160 frames x 250 steps). Final K2 biomass share: 0.93 vs twin 0.46 (s21) and 0.78 vs 0.30 (s22); by cell count at t=40000: 14/18 vs 7/16 and 8/15 vs 6/17 (counts.txt). The up arm is volatile: on s22 K2 reached 0.9 of biomass at t~15000, fell to 0 by t~21000 when its few large cells were lost, and swept again only after a new flip at t~33000 (k2_share.png). Cells form from noise through a single surviving founder (sheet t=1750), divide (7-11 persistent splits, generation 3-4), and the L ring is borderline (rim/core 1.44-1.47 in the up arm, 1.51-1.54 in the twin).

observations.I: up/seed22/sheet.png: 15-20 discrete walled cells from t~10000
observations.D: up/seed21/FACTS.md: 11 persistent splits, generation 3; up/seed22/FACTS.md: 7, generation 4
observations.H: k2_share.png, counts.txt: up arm ends above its identical-event twin on both seeds (biomass 0.93/0.46, 0.78/0.30; count 0.78/0.44, 0.53/0.35)

seeds_run.result: pass at t=40000 (up > twin), but K2 was lost entirely between t~21000 and t~33000

controls_run.H: twin/seed21, twin/seed22: identical-event twin (membrane_evo, b2 = b) on the same seeds

verdicts.limitation: Two seeds; the neutral twin itself reaches 0.30-0.46 K2 share, so drift is large next to the effect; the sweep rides on a few large K2 cells (biomass share exceeds count share) and can be lost and restarted (s22); B is borderline (L rim/core 1.44-1.47 < 1.5 in the up arm), so I do not support the [L3] bracket; deaths are imposed disks, so this does not bear on C:autonomous-heredity.
